summary: The second decision registry is removed, the two V8-S1 findings are distinguished, the normative lock/custody contract remains closed, and every v8-to-v9 delta path is named. The fixture repair is not reproducible at review time, however: v9 cites the moving v2 candidate at e2781f44..., while the cited path now hashes to 70248781... and binds itself to schemas.v9. That leaves one SHOULD-FIX. Two repair-accounting discrepancies are advisory-grade.

shouldFix.title: The repaired fixture-corpus v2 citation is already stranded from the bytes at its cited path
shouldFix.detail: V9 /whatThisDoesNotDo/1 cites component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v2.json at e2781f449599909c7b2bfc8d827591911323f8633e2b5f419fcb27e772e6c9da and describes it as reviewStatus DRAFT-AWAITING-SCHEMA-SUCCESSOR. Python hashlib remeasurement of that path during this review produced 70248781118452308399e91fcbecb7cac37dd5d58fd03c49ac9efcec445341d5, not e2781f44.... The live candidate still has the stated reviewStatus and remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / binds NOTHING, but its schemaContract now pins this v9 subject at 52b3ab93d531d7e229f098deef8d944040bc93461c3e5c70be775002a6f7b791 and its authorityClaim calls it a successor draft against schemas.v9. The e2781f44... bytes were the earlier draft against v8; the file is untracked and those old bytes are not recoverable from the repository's Git history. The repair that was supposed to make a moving draft citation reproducible therefore does not resolve the bytes currently named by its path.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The underlying existence, draft standing, and non-authorization claims remain true, so this is not a blocker. It is still the same acceptance-bar property Codex V8-S1 and Claude V8-A3 required: an exact digest is useful only if it identifies retained or resolvable bytes. A stale hash beside a mutable untracked path cannot reproduce the empirical citation.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: In a successor, cite the exact retained v2 candidate bytes actually reviewed. Either pin the current candidate's full digest and freeze those bytes for the review interval, or retain the e2781f44... snapshot at an immutable/content-addressed path and label it explicitly as the prior authoring snapshot. Preserve CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and the explicit not-accepted, not-qualified, not-applied, and not-DR-103-SATISFIED boundary.

advisories.title: The V8-A3 repair entry imports a v1-verdict-citation defect that belongs to Codex V8-S1
advisories.detail: Claude's actual V8-A3 title is 'The two fixture-corpus candidates are cited asymmetrically - v1 at a digest, v2 without one'; its advice asks for the v2 digest and reviewStatus. V9 repairLog[56] instead titles V8-A3 'Fixture-corpus v2 unpinned and v1 REJECT outcome uncited at digest' and gives it the two v1-verdict operations. The uncited v1 disposition is Codex V8-S1's second aspect and is already recorded correctly and separately at repairLog[57]. A successor should restore Claude V8-A3's actual title and limit its attributed remedy to the v2 citation, leaving the v1-verdict citation under CODEX-V8-S1.
advisories.notBlocking: No finding id is fabricated, both source verdicts are pinned, and the extra operations are substantively warranted by the separately logged Codex finding. The defect is attribution precision inside the audit log, not missing contract work.

advisories.title: The closed method roster contains the right entries but not in repairLog order
advisories.detail: /basedOn/method lists V8-S1, CODEX-V8-S1, V8-A3, META-v9. The four appended entries are V8-S1, V8-A3, CODEX-V8-S1, META-v9. The set is exact and closed, but prior lineage reviews treated roster order as part of the direct audit mapping. A successor should make the parenthesized roster sequence equal the append sequence.
advisories.notBlocking: No entry is omitted or invented, and order does not affect path coverage; every one of the 19 minimal changed paths remains named.

attackListDisposition.detail: lockSchema, testCorpusRequirements, identityDependencies, and rejectionRules are value-identical to v8. Purpose, both request forms, resolution semantics, and ID-DEP-4 forbid any lock until DR-111 closes; TC-ACCEPT, TC-SIG, and TC-BYTE-EXACT gate their lock-bearing members; RJ-4 keeps its lock-digest arm inactive. The live register still records DR-111 OPEN.

attackListDisposition.detail: A recursive minimal-path comparison found 19 changed, added, or removed paths. V8-S1 names removal of /openDecisions, addition of OD-2, and the carried-decision reference; V8-A3/CODEX-V8-S1 name /whatThisDoesNotDo/1; META-v9 names succession/apply/guidance changes; the four repair entries self-account. repairLog[0:55] and review-guidance[0:12] are value-identical to v8.
The roster has exactly the four appended ids and no future-fold hedge. Its sequence differs from repairLog order as V9-A2 records.

The header remains DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE / CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW / DO-NOT-SEAL / binds NOTHING with authorityClaim NONE. The fixture clause denies acceptance, qualification, application, and DR-103 satisfaction; this review grants none of them.
